name: reqcore
//engines: Must match the Dockerfile builder image. The dependency tree itself requires node ^22.18 || >=24.11 (@babel/generator 8), and a lockfile regenerated on a different npm MAJOR is rejected by `npm ci` inside the image — the only symptom either way is a failed Docker build. .nvmrc carries the same number for `nvm use`.
//ai-sdk-ceilings: MEASURED 2026-08-12. The tail of every current AI-SDK major is under advisory: ai 6.0.238-6.0.250, @ai-sdk/anthropic 3.0.104-3.0.110, google 3.0.103-3.0.107, openai 3.0.90-3.0.94, and provider-utils 4.0.41-4.0.45 — which pulls undici ^5.29.0, and ALL of undici 5.x is inside GHSA-vrm6-8vpv-qv8q (<=6.27.0), the one HIGH that fails ./verify.sh. No fixed release exists inside these majors: the fix is ai 7 / @ai-sdk 4 / provider-utils 5, a breaking upgrade through the scoring and shortlisting path that needs its own review. These ceilings hold the tree where it already runs (ai 6.0.168 in production) instead of crossing a major inside a sync. REMOVE THEM with that upgrade — they also block genuine fixes. Upstream v1.6.0 carries plain carets and is exposed the moment its lockfile is regenerated.
//overrides: The security overrides below are RANGES, not exact pins — the argument in reqcore-inc/reqcore#273: upstream hand-bumped them five times in five months and on b269934 moved tar BACKWARDS into GHSA-vmf3-w455-68vh's range for a day. Every floor is max(this fork's, upstream v1.6.0's pin), so using ranges never lowers a version upstream had already reached. Note npm rejects a comment key inside `overrides` itself — every key there must be a package name.

scripts.start:railway: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && node .output/server/index.mjs
scripts.dev: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 LAUNCH_EDITOR=zed systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryHigh=5G -p MemoryMax=6G nuxt dev
scripts.db:reseed: npx tsx server/scripts/delete-demo-org.ts && npx tsx server/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.i18n:crowdin:sync: npm run i18n:crowdin:upload && npm run i18n:crowdin:download
